title: [Bug] Anthropic API Error: Invalid message format with thinking blocks
body:
**Bug Description**
cant use claude code constnatly getting ⏺ Read(docker/docker-bake.hcl)
  ⎿  Read 89 lines
  ⎿ API Error: 400
    {"type":"error","error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"messages.5.content.0: If an
    assistant message contains any thinking blocks, the first block must be `thinking` or
    `redacted_thinking`. Found `text`."},"request_id":"req_011CXT8bUDaez2FNQumfnTPe"}

top_comments.body: Same issue here — #20717. This appears to be a regression from today (Jan 25). At least 7 issues reported in the last few hours: #20691, #20692, #20698, #20711, #20717, #20725, #20726. Thinking mode is completely unusable with tool calls. If you're affected, please upvote and comment on the related issues to help get this fixed\!
